synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — a binary single-asset clinical bet: uniformly bullish sell-side and funded runway offset by deepening burn, dilution and an unexplained gap-down.

bull_points.claim: This is a pre-revenue clinical-stage biotech whose value rests on a single lead asset, TX45, which just completed enrollment in its APEX Phase 2 trial in PH-HFpEF — a dated, de-risking milestone that moves the program toward its readout.

bull_points.claim: TX45 already produced positive topline Phase 1b Part B acute-hemodynamic data in Group 2 PH-HFrEF, the clinical signal underpinning the runway thesis for the later-stage program.

bull_points.claim: The balance sheet carries net cash of ~$223M against only ~$4.4M of total debt (leases), giving the program funding runway to reach its Phase 2 readout without imminent leverage risk.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Net Debt ÷ CIQ LTM EBITDA (EDGAR XBRL breadth fallback) + FCF sign (survival capacity)

bull_points.claim: Sell-side coverage is uniformly constructive — 9 Buy / 1 Outperform ratings with a mean target of $77.56 versus a $26.50 close — i.e. consensus prices a large clinical-success runway well above the current level.

Recent GAAP-EPS revision breadth for FY2026 is entirely upward (8 up / 0 down last month), and loss estimates narrowed on 2026-08-09 broker moves — the near-term consensus path is being marked less negative, not more.

bear_points.claim: The peer discount is the wrong lens here: the comp set is flagged HETEROGENEOUS with market caps spanning $105M–$15.0B (142x) around a $585M name, so the peer TEV/Rev median (149.5x LTM / 47.46x NTM) is anchored by differently-scaled businesses and is not a clean benchmark for TX45's value.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Financial Data (market-cap dispersion) + Business Description

bear_points.claim: TEV/EBITDA and P/E are NM as a REAL state, not missing: EBITDA is genuinely negative (LTM $-94M) and deepening — this is not an optical-margin misread but a true absence of earnings to multiply.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name row + Summary Statistics Low/Median/Mean/High)

bear_points.claim: The cash burn is real and worsening: LTM levered FCF is $-46.7M and the absolute EBITDA loss has deepened every year (Dec-2021 -15 → LTM -94), and consensus expects the loss to widen further (FY26E EBITDA $-89M → FY27E $-105M) — the trajectory is away from, not toward, profitability.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

bear_points.claim: Shareholders have been diluted ~32.5% in ~1.7 years (14.75M → 19.55M shares) against a dense shelf/prospectus-supplement history, so equity funding of the burn is an ongoing dilution cost, not a one-off.

The stock already gapped down ~-40% intraday on 2026-08-31 with no company filing to explain it, and has lagged its small-cap benchmark by ~30 points over 180 days — idiosyncratic weakness the sources leave unexplained.
bear_points.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

bear_points.claim: Value is single-asset and binary: with $0 revenue consensus for FY26/FY27 and no segment or geographic breakout available, the entire thesis rides on TX45 clinical outcomes with no diversifying business beneath it.

caveats: ALSO A CURRENT SCREEN CANDIDATE at rank 174 — judged under the 'quality' book, not 'overshoot', by operator ruling: Operator ruling 2026-09-23: the QUALITY book owns this name, not the screen. The 2026-09-22 screen admitted TECX at rank 174 of 289 - it fell 32.2 points further than its industry cohort (Biological Products, 55 peers) over the screen's window - so the follow reason's premise, that the name fails the screen's entry gates on their own terms, no longer holds. The follow stands regardless: the binding question is still what the price assumes about the APEX (PH-HFpEF) topline guided to early Q1 2027, and a de-rating does not convert a single-readout underwrite into an overshoot. The gate sentence in the follow reason is STALE as of this date and is superseded by this ruling. Follow reason: Clinical-stage heart-and-lung biotech followed under the QUALITY book, accepted by the operator 2026-09-01. One drug matters: TX45, for pulmonary hypertension caused by heart failure. Phase 1b was positive in both heart-failure types (HFpEF, and HFrEF topline 2025-10-29); the Phase 2 that decides it (APEX, PH-HFpEF) completed enrolment 2026-06-10, its independent data monitoring committee recommended continuation without modification in July 2026, and topline is guided to early Q1 2027. Cash of $227.1M at 2026-06-30 is guided to fund operations into Q1 2029 — the company reaches its own answer without needing to raise. The binding question is therefore what the price already assumes about that one readout, not whether a de-rating is overdone: nothing broke here, so the overshoot twin's question does not apply. The $300M-$10B band answers where the fund HUNTS, not what it may hold or follow; this name sits inside the band but fails the screen's entry gates on their own terms (down 22% from its 52w high against a 30% floor, and AHEAD of IWM over 180d), which is the screen behaving correctly rather than a gap to route around.

business_description.value: Tectonic Therapeutic, Inc., a biotechnology company, focuses on the discovery and development of therapeutic proteins and antibodies to modulate the activity of G protein coupled receptors (GPCRs). It develops GEODe technology platform to enable the discovery and development of GPCR-targeted biologic medicines. The company’s lead product is TX45, a Fc-relaxin fusion molecule that activates the RXFP1 receptor, the GPCR target of the hormone, and relaxin. It is also developing TX2100 for the treatment of hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia; GPCR modulator bispecific for treating fibrosis; and other GPCR modulators. The company is headquartered in Watertown, Massachusetts.

historical_forecast_error.estimate_type: final consensus before each result — CIQ Estimates→Surprise 'Estimate', Fiscal Years, company level
historical_forecast_error.eligibility_note: Each observation is the consensus on the eve of the result — lead time ~0 — so it measures last-mile surprise: a cross-check on scenario severity and on how wrong late consensus has been. It is NOT a distribution of how far consensus moves over a holding period; that needs point-in-time consensus snapshots, which no Estimates Report carries.
historical_forecast_error.usage_note: EBIT- or EBITDA-level shock today: error_per_forecast_revenue × today's revenue consensus. Revenue × margin scenario: the SAME year's Revenue pct_error and ratio_error, kept together. ratio_error alone answers how wrong the margin (or capex-intensity) forecast was, and multiplied by revenue it drops the revenue miss's effect. Exact identity: error_per_forecast_revenue = ratio_error + (actual ÷ actual revenue) × (actual revenue ÷ forecast revenue − 1).
